process.title: Service Delivery Process
process.description: A structured methodology to keep implementation and installation projects on schedule and aligned with specifications.

01.title: Consultation & Site Survey
01.description: Our technical team conducts an in-depth initial assessment of specific needs and actual site conditions.

02.title: Solution Design & Engineering
02.description: Preparation of engineering documents, instrument specifications, and efficient budget estimates.

03.title: Installation & Integration
03.description: Physical installation, wiring, and IoT device/instrument integration by experienced technicians.

05.title: Training & Handover
05.description: Comprehensive operator training and handover of warranty certificates and official documentation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
faq.description: Quick answers about our quality commitment, warranty coverage, and service procedures.

calibration.question: Does Autentik provide officially certified calibration services?
calibration.answer: Yes. Our equipment calibration and validation follow ISO/IEC 17025 international standard methods and are performed by certified specialists.

system.question: Can the IoT system be adapted to our plant’s needs?
system.answer: Certainly. Our IoT hardware and cloud monitoring dashboards are developed in-house with a modular approach, allowing adaptation to your plant’s existing protocols and sensors.

warranty.question: How long is the service and hardware warranty?
warranty.answer: We provide an official component and technical-service warranty of up to 12–24 months, depending on the service package, together with after-sales technical support.

survey.question: How do I request a site survey or initial consultation?
survey.answer: Contact our technical team using the Contact Our Service Team button below, or through WhatsApp/email. Our team is ready to respond within one working day.

cta.title: Need Service Advice & Custom Solutions?
cta.description: Our engineers are ready to provide technical advice, site surveys, and competitive quotations for your laboratory and industrial projects.
